name: Lucie
source:
A young woman who's recently turned 18 and aiming to make herself known in the conniving world of business for her cure to vampirism. She was once a vampire...will she continue to be one?

"Ha! What room could they have for doubt when I'm testing the cure on myself?"

Dislikes: people who talk too much & too long, lengthy legal documents, Nemo
Likes: puzzles & riddles, Nemo
